title: Session Message Class v1
description: Shared primitive for classifying a session message by role. Used by hyphae, canopy, and cap to distinguish user, assistant, tool, and meta messages without embedding tool-specific fields. Enum is open-for-extension: consumers should handle unknown values gracefully.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Always '1.0' for this schema.

message_id.description: Identifier of the classified message, assigned by the producer so consumers can correlate the classification back to its source.

message_class.description: Classification of the message. 'meta' covers injected context (memory surfaces, session headers, protocol preambles). New values may be added in later schema versions; consumers must tolerate unknown values.

meta_reason.description: Optional annotation explaining why a message was classified 'meta'. Examples: 'session_context_injection', 'memory_protocol_surface'. Null or absent when message_class is not 'meta'.
